robot: Sharpa Wave dexterous hand (22 finger joints) on a six-axis wrist stage (three prismatic and three serial revolute joints), no arm

frame.base_text: the scene's world frame (+Z up; the wrist stage is fixed in it): the coordinates of the task text

arm.note: the wrist stage: wrist_x, wrist_y, wrist_z (m, translations along the world axes; the task text says where they are measured from) then wrist_rx, wrist_ry, wrist_rz (rad, serial X-Y-Z joints); joint_positions only (no end-effector pose command); its measured hand-mount pose is reported as ee

right_hand.note: Sharpa Wave finger joint targets (rad, 22, in the spec layout order: thumb CMC_FE, CMC_AA, MCP_FE, MCP_AA, IP; index, middle, ring MCP_FE, MCP_AA, PIP, DIP; pinky CMC, MCP_FE, MCP_AA, PIP, DIP); no scalar gripper: grasp by closing the fingers on the object

resets.note: 20 resets in all (describe_robot resets.budget). Only the last episode is graded, and a success ends the run.

notes: One dexterous hand on a wrist stage: move the stage (part arm) and the fingers (part right_hand) with joint positions. Every column is a position target (servo); grasping and carrying work only through contact. The parts follow the Sharpa Wave layout (describe_robot spec_file: hand "sharpa"). With the Wuji hand (hand "wuji", 20 finger joints per hand) the columns differ: use execute_trajectory space native with the order in spec action_types.joint_position.layout. Rows are 0.02 s apart or a multiple of it; a call covers at most 10 s. Measured poses are in the world frame of the task text, quaternions wxyz.
